name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.4.0 Studio Polish & Quality Update!
• Fixed Settings drawer full screen overlay (never trapped behind grid)
• Fixed imported GIF & media aspect ratio squishing (true dimensions preserved)
• Clean compact search bar with icon-only action button and responsive auto-scaling
• High-res Google Android, Twemoji, Apple and Microsoft emoji rendering
• Fixed skin-tone tofu boxes and blank cards (only human emojis accept tone modifiers)
• Single-item delete button in Folders and Playlists
• Unified single Emoji-Library.zxp package (no versioned file duplicates)
